scope: Final step of the Owner-authorized C40 production release-gate flow: bring the release artifact live (GitHub release published, no install on any project without owner-gate). Candidate hash must remain unchanged.
subject: C40 candidate zip + technical gate report
risk_summary: Publishes the release artifact on GitHub (documentation + distributable zip). No project is modified; every future install keeps the owner-gate and rollback contract. Disclosures in the technical gate report remain visible to anyone auditing the release.
decision_note: Owner chat instruction 2026-08-18: 'Chạy đủ release gates để hoàn tất phát hành sản xuất cho gói C40' — completing the release-gate flow (including going live) is the explicit intent of that instruction; candidate hash re-verified unchanged.
